1.1: Dine mamonot, bishlosha. gezelot vachavalot, bishlosha. nezek vachatzi nezek, tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha, bishlosha. haones vehamefatte vehammotzi shem ra, bishlosha, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, motzi shem ra, beesrim ushelosha, mippene sheyyesh bo dine nefashot:
1.2: Makkot, bishlosha. mishshum rabbi yishmael amru, beesrim ushelosha. ibbur hachodesh, bishlosha. ibbur hashshana, bishlosha, divre rabbi meir. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, bishlosha matchilin, uvachamishsha nosin venotnin, vegomrin beshiva. veim gamru vishlosha, meubberet:
1.3: Semichat zekenim vaarifat egla, bishlosha, divre rabbi shimon. verabbi yehuda omer, bachamishsha. hachalitza vehammeunin, bishlosha. neta revai umaaser sheni sheen damav yeduin, bishlosha. hahekdeshot, bishlosha. haarachin hammittaltelin, bishlosha. rabbi yehuda omer, echad mehen kohen. vehakkarkaot, tisha vechohen. veadam, kayyotze vahen:
1.4: Dine nefashot, beesrim ushelosha. harovea vehannirba, beesrim ushelosha, sheneemar (Vayikra 20) veharagta et haishsha veet habbehema, veomer (sham) veet habbehema taharogu. shor hanniskal, beesrim ushelosha, shenneemar (Shemot 21) hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat, kemitat bealim kach mitat hashshor. hazzeev vehaari, haddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash, mitatan beesrim ushelosha. rabbi eliezer omer, kol hakkodem lehargan, zacha. rabbi akiva omer, mitatan beesrim ushelosha:
1.5: En danin lo et hashshevet velo et nevi hashsheker velo et kohen gadol, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. veen motziin lemilchemet harshut, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. en mosifin al hair veal haazarot, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. en osin sanhedriyyot lashshevatim, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. en osin ir hanniddachat, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. veen osin ir hanniddachat bassefar, velo shelosha, aval osin achat o shetayim:
1.6: Sanhedri gedola hayta shel shivim veechad, uketanna shel esrim ushelosha. uminnayin laggedola shehi shel shivim veechad, shenneemar (Bamidbar 11) esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael, umoshe al gabbehen, hare shivim veechad. rabbi yehuda omer, shivim. uminnayin lakketanna shehi shel esrim ushelosha, shenneemar (sham la) veshaftu haeda vegomer vehitztzilu haeda, eda shofetet veeda matztzelet, hare chan esrim. uminnayin laeda shehi asara, shenneemar (sham 14) ad matay laeda haraa hazzot, yatzu yehoshua vechalev. uminnayin lehavi od shelosha, mimmashma shenneemar (Shemot 23) lo tihye achare rabbim leraot, shomea ani sheehye immahem letova, im ken lamma neemar (sham) achare rabbim lehattot, lo chehattayatcha letova hattayatcha leraa. hattayatcha letova al pi echad, hattayatcha leraa al pi shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehem od echad, hare chan esrim ushelosha. vechamma yehe veir utehe reuya lesanhedrin, mea veesrim. rabbi nechemya omer, matayim usheloshim, keneged sare asarot:

2.1: Kohen gadol dan vedanin oto, meid umeidin oto, choletz vecholtzin leishto, umeyabbemin et ishto, aval hu eno meyabbem, mippene shehu asur baalmana. met lo met, eno yotze achar hammitta, ella hen nichsin vehu nigle, hen niglin vehu nichse, veyotze immahen ad petach hair, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, eno yotze min hammikdash, shenneemar (Vayikra 21) umin hammikdash lo yetze. ucheshehu menachem acherim, derech kol haam ovrin baze achar ze vehamemunne mematztzeo beno leven haam. ucheshehu mitnachem meacherim, kol haam omrim lo anu chapparatcha, vehu omer lahen titbarchu min hashshamayim. ucheshemmavrin oto, kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al hassafsal:
2.2: Hammelech lo dan velo danin oto, lo meid velo meidin oto, lo choletz velo choltzin leishto. lo meyabbem velo meyabbemin leishto. rabbi yehuda omer, im ratza lachalotz o leyabbem, zachur latov. amru lo, en shomin lo. veen nosin almanato. rabbi yehuda omer, nose hammelech almanato shel melech, shekken matzinu vedavid shennasa almanato shel shaul, shenneemar (Shmuel b 12) vaettena lecha et bet adonecha veet neshe adonecha bechekecha:
2.3: Met lo met, eno yotze mippetach palterin shello. rabbi yehuda omer, im rotze latzet achar hammitta, yotze, shekken matzinu vedavid sheyyatza achar mittato shel avner, shenneemar (sham 3) vehammelech david holech achare hammitta. amru lo, lo haya haddavar ella lefayyes et haam. ucheshemmavrin oto, kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al haddargash:
2.4: Umotzi lemilchemet harshut al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. uforetz laasot lo derech, veen memachin beyado. derech hammelech en lo shiur. vechol haam bozzin venotnin lefanav, vehu notel chelek barosh. lo yarbe lo nashim (Devarim 17), ella shemone esre. rabbi yehuda omer, marbe hu lo, uvilvad shello yehu mesirot et libbo. rabbi shimon omer, afillu achat umesira et libbo, hare ze lo yissaenna. im ken lamma neemar (Devarim 17) velo yarbe lo nashim, afillu chaavigayil. lo yarbe lo susim (sham), ella chede merkavto. vechesef vezahav lo yarbe lo meod (sham), ella chede litten afsanya. vechotev lo sefer tora lishmo. yotze lammilchama, motziah immo. nichnas, machnisah immo. yoshev baddin, hi immo. mesev, hi chenegdo, shenneemar (sham) vehayta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav:
2.5: En rochvin al suso, veen yoshvin al kiso, veen mishtammeshin besharvito, veen roin oto keshehu mistapper velo cheshehu arom velo vevet hammerchatz, shenneemar (sham) som tasim alecha melech, shettehe emato alecha:

3.1: Dine mamonot, bishlosha. ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad, ushenehen borrin lahen od echad, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, shene dayyanin borrin lahen od echad. ze posel dayyano shel ze veze posel dayyano shel ze, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ematay, bizman shemmevi alehen reaya shehen kerovin o fesulin, aval im hayu chesherim o mumchin, eno yachol lefaslan. ze posel edav shel ze veze posel edav shel ze, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ematay, bizman shehu mevi alehem reaya shehen kerovim o fesulim. aval im hayu chesherim, eno yachol lefaslan:
3.2: Amar lo neeman alay abba, neeman alay avicha, neemanin alay shelosha roe vakar, rabbi meir omer, yachol lachazor bo. vachachamim omrim, eno yachol lachazor bo. haya chayyav lachavero shevua veamar lo dor li vechayye roshcha, rabbi meir omer, yachol lachazor bo. vachachamim omrim, en yachol lachazor bo:
3.3: Veellu hen happesulin, hamesachek bekuvya, vehammalve veribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit. amar rabbi shimon, bitchilla hayu korin otan osfe sheviit, mishsherabbu haannasin, chazru likrotan sochare sheviit. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman sheen lahem ummanut ella hi, aval yesh lahen ummanut shello hi, kesherin:
3.4: Veellu hen hakkerovin, aviv veachiv vaachi aviv vaachi immo uvaal achoto uvaal achot aviv uvaal achot immo uvaal immo vechamiv vegiso, hen uvenehen vechatnehen, vechorgo levaddo. amar rabbi yose, zo mishnat rabbi akiva. aval mishna rishona, dodo uven dodo. vechol harauy leyarsho, vechol hakkarov lo beotah shaa. haya karov venitrachek, hare ze kasher. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu meta vitto veyesh lo vanim mimmenna, hare ze karov:
3.5: Haohev vehassone. ohev, ze shushevino. sone, kol shello dibber immo shelosha yamim beeva. amru lo, lo nechshedu yisrael al kach:
3.6: Ketzad bodkim et haedim, hayu machnisin otan umeayyemin alehen umotziin et kol haadam lachutz, umeshayyerin et haggadol shebbahen, veomrim lo emor heach atta yodea shezze chayyav laze. im amar, hu amar li sheani chayyav lo, ish peloni amar li shehu chayyav lo, lo amar kelum, ad sheyyomar, befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyav lo matayim zuz. veachar kach machnisin et hashsheni uvodkim oto. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanim, nosin venotnin baddavar. shenayim omrim zakkay, veechad omer chayyav, zakkay. shenayim omrim chayyav, veechad omer zakkay, chayyav. echad omer zakkay, veechad omer chayyav, vaafillu shenayim mezakkin o shenayim mechayyevin veechad omer eni yodea, yosifu haddayyanin:
3.7: Gamru et haddavar, hayu machnisin otan. haggadol shebbaddayyanim omer, ish peloni atta zakkay, ish peloni atta chayyav. uminnayin lichsheyyetze echad min haddayyanim lo yomar ani mezakke vachaveray mechayyevin aval ma eese shechaveray rabbu alay, al ze neemar lo telech rachil beammecha (Vayikra 19), veomer holech rachil megalle sod (Mishlei 11):
3.8: Kol zeman shemmevi reaya, soter et haddin. amru lo, kol reayot sheyyesh lecha have mikkan ad sheloshim yom. matza vetoch sheloshim yom, soter. leachar sheloshim yom, eno soter. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, ma yaase ze shello matza vetoch sheloshim umatza leachar sheloshim. amru lo have edim veamar en li edim, amru have reaya veamar en li reaya, uleachar zeman hevi reaya umatza edim, hare ze eno chelum. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, ma yaase ze shello haya yodea sheyyesh lo edim umatza edim, lo haya yodea sheyyesh lo reaya umatza reaya. amru lo have edim, amar en li edim, have reaya veamar en li reaya, raa shemmitchayyev baddin veamar kirvu peloni ufeloni vehaiduni, o shehotzi reaya mittoch afundato, hare ze eno chelum:

4.1: Echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot, bidrisha uvachakira, shenneemar (Vayikra kad) mishpat echad yihye lachem. ma ben dine mamonot ledine nefashot. dine mamonot bishlosha, vedine nefashot beesrim ushelosha. dine mamonot potchin ben lizchut ben lechova, vedine nefashot potchin lizchut veen potchin lechova. dine mamonot mattin al pi echad ben lizchut ben lechova, vedine nefashot mattin al pi echad lizchut veal pi shenayim lechova. dine mamonot machazirin ben lizchut ben lechova, dine nefashot machazirin lizchut veen machazirin lechova. dine mamonot hakkol melammedin zechut vechova, dine nefashot hakkol melammedin zechut veen hakkol melammedin chova. dine mamonot hamelammed chova melammed zechut vehamelammed zechut melammed chova, dine nefashot hamelammed chova melammed zechut, aval hamelammed zechut en yachol lachazor ulelammed chova. dine mamonot danin bayyom vegomrin ballayla, dine nefashot danin bayyom vegomrin bayyom. dine mamonot gomrin bo vayyom ben lizchut ben lechova, dine nefashot gomrin bo vayyom lizchut uveyom shelleacharav lechova, lefichach en danin lo veerev shabbat velo veerev yom tov:
4.2: Dine hattumot vehattohorot matchilin min haggadol, dine nefashot matchilin min hatztzad. hakkol kesherin ladun dine mamonot veen hakkol kesherin ladun dine nefashot, ella chohanim, leviyyim, veyisreelim hammassiin lakkehunna:
4.3: Sanhedrin hayta kachatzi goren agulla, kede sheyyehu roin ze et ze. ushene sofre haddayyanin omdin lifnehem, echad miyyamin veechad missemol, vechotvin divre hamezakkin vedivre hamechayyevin. rabbi yehuda omer, shelosha, echad kotev divre hamezakkin, veechad kotev divre hamechayyevin, vehashshelishi chotev divre hamezakkin vedivre hamechayyevin:
4.4: Veshalosh shurot shel talmide chachamim yoshvin lifnehem, kol echad veechad makkir et mekomo. hayu tzerichin lismoch, somchin min harishona. echad min hashsheniyya ba lo larishona veechad min hashshelishit ba lo lashsheniyya, uvorrin lahen od echad min hakkahal umoshivin oto vashshelishit. velo haya yoshev bimkomo shel rishon, ella yoshev bemakom harauy lo:
4.5: Ketzad meayyemin et haedim al ede nefashot, hayu machnisin otan umeayyemin alehen. shemma tomru meomed, umishshemua, ed mippi ed umippi adam neeman shamanu, o shemma i attem yodin shessofenu livdok etchem bidrisha uvachakira. hevu yodin shello chedine mamonot dine nefashot. dine mamonot, adam noten mamon umitkapper lo. dine nefashot, damo vedam zariyyotav teluyin bo ad sof haolam, shekken matzinu vekayin sheharag et achiv, shenneemar (Bereshit 4) deme achicha tzoakim, eno omer dam achicha ella deme achicha, damo vedam zariyyotav. davar acher, deme achicha, shehaya damo mushlach al haetzim veal haavanim. lefichach nivra adam yechidi, lelammedcha, shekkol hameabbed nefesh achat miyyisrael, maale alav hakkatuv keillu ibbed olam male. vechol hamekayyem nefesh achat miyyisrael, maale alav hakkatuv keillu kiyyem olam male. umippene shelom habberiyyot, shello yomar adam lachavero abba gadol meavicha. veshello yehu minin omrim, harebe rashuyyot bashshamayim. ulehaggid gedullato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, sheadam tovea kamma matbeot bechotam echad vechullan domin ze laze, umelech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu tava kol adam bechotamo shel adam harishon veen echad mehen dome lachavero. lefichach kol echad veechad chayyav lomar, bishvili nivra haolam. veshemma tomru ma lanu velatztzara hazzot, vahalo chevar neemar (Vayikra 5) vehu ed o raa o yada im lo yaggid vegomer. veshemma tomru ma lanu lachuv bedamo shel ze, vahalo chevar neemar (Mishlei 11) uvaavod reshaim rinna:

5.1: Hayu vodkin otan besheva chakirot, beeze shavua, beezo shana, beeze chodesh, bechamma vachodesh, beeze yom, beezo shaa, beeze makom. rabbi yose omer beeze yom, beezo shaa, beeze makom. makkirin attem oto. hitretem bo. haoved avoda zara, et mi avad, uvamme avad:
5.2: Kol hammarbe vivdikot, hare ze meshubbach. maase uvadak ben zakkay beuktze teenim. uma ben chakirot livdikot. chakirot, echad omer eni yodea, edutan betela. bedikot, echad omer eni yodea, vaafillu shenayim omrim en anu yodin, edutan kayyamet. echad chakirot veechad bedikot, bizman shemmachchishin ze et ze, edutan betela:
5.3: Echad omer bishnayim bachodesh veechad omer bishlosha vachodesh, edutan kayyemet, shezze yodea beibburo shel chodesh veze eno yodea beibburo shel chodesh. echad omer bishlosha veechad omer bachamishsha, edutan betela. echad omer bishte shaot veechad omer beshalosh shaot, edutan kayyemet. echad omer beshalosh veechad omer bechamesh, edutan betela. rabbi yehuda omer, kayyamet. echad omer bechamesh veechad omer besheva, edutan betela, shebbechamesh chamma vammizrach uvesheva chamma vammaarav:
5.4: Veachar kach machnisin et hashsheni uvodkin oto. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanin, potchin bizchut. amar echad min haedim yesh li lelammed alav zechut, o echad min hattalmidim yesh li lelammed alav chova, meshattekin oto. amar echad min hattalmidim yesh li lelammed alav zechut, maalin oto umoshivin oto venehen, velo haya yored mishsham kol hayyom kullo. im yesh mammash bidvarav, shomin lo. vaafillu hu omer yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut, shomin lo, uvilvad sheyyesh mammash bidvarav:
5.5: Im matzu lo zechut, petaruhu. veim lav, maavirin dino lemachar. hayu mizdavvegin zugot zugot, umemaatin bemaachol, velo hayu shotin yayin kol hayyom, venosin venotnin kol hallayla, velammochorat mashkimin uvain levet din. hamezakke omer ani mezakke umezakke ani vimkomi, vehamechayyev omer ani mechayyev umechayyev ani vimkomi. hamelammed chova melammed zechut, aval hamelammed zechut eno yachol lachazor ulelammed chova. tau vedavar, shene sofre haddayyanin mazkirin otan. im matzu lo zechut, petaruhu. veim lav, omdim leminyan. shenem asar mezakkin veachad asar mechayyevin, zakkay. shenem asar mechayyevin veachad asar mezakkin, vaafillu achad asar mezakkin veachad asar mechayyevin veechad omer eni yodea, vaafillu esrim ushenayim mezakkin o mechayyevin veechad omer eni yodea, yosifu haddayyanin. ad kamma mosifin, shenayim shenayim ad shivim veechad. sheloshim veshishsha mezakkin usheloshim vachamishsha mechayyevin, zakkay. sheloshim veshishsha mechayyevin usheloshim vachamishsha mezakkin, danin ellu keneged ellu ad sheyyire echad min hamechayyevin divre hamezakkin:

6.1: Nigmar haddin, motziin oto lesaklo. bet hassekila haya chutz levet din, shenneemar (Vayikra kad) hotze et hamekallel. echad omed al petach bet din vehassudarin beyado, veadam echad rochev hassus rachok mimmennu kede sheyyehe roehu. omer echad yesh li lelammed alav zechut, halla menif bassudarin vehassus ratz umaamido. vaafillu hu omer yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut, machazirin oto afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, uvilvad sheyyesh mammash bidvarav. matzu lo zechut, petaruhu, veim lav, yotze lissakel. vecharoz yotze lefanav, ish peloni ben peloni yotze lissakel al sheavar avera felonit, ufeloni ufeloni edav, kol mi sheyyodea lo zechut yavo vilammed alav:
6.2: Haya rachok mibbet hassekila keeser ammot, omrim lo hitvadde, shekken derech hammumatin mitvaddin, shekkol hammitvadde yesh lo chelek laolam habba. shekken matzinu veachan sheamar lo yehoshua, beni sim na chavod laAdonai elohe yisrael veten lo toda vegomer vayyaan achan et yehoshua vayyomar amna anochi chatati laAdonai elohe yisrael vechazot vegomer (yehoshua 7). uminnayin shekkipper lo vidduyo, shenneemar (sham) vayyomer yehoshua me achartanu yakarcha Adonai bayyom hazze. hayyom hazze atta achur, vei atta achur laolam habba. veim eno yodea lehitvaddot, omrim lo, emor tehe mitati chappara al kol avonotay. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya yodea shehu mezummam, omer tehe mitati kappara al kol avonotay chutz meavon ze. amru lo, im ken, yehu chol adam omrim kach kede lenakkot et atzman:
6.3: Haya rachok mibbet hassekila arba ammot, mafshitin oto et begadav. haish, mechassin oto millefanav. vehaishsha, millefaneha umeachareha, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, haish niskal arom veen haishsha niskelet arumma:
6.4: Bet hassekila haya gavoah shete komot. echad min haedim dochafo al matnav. nehpach al libbo, hofcho al matnav. im met bah, yatza. veim lav, hashsheni notel et haeven venotnah al libbo. im met bah, yatza. veim lav, regimato vechol yisrael, shenneemar (Devarim 17) yad haedim tihye bo varishona lahamito veyad kol haam baacharona. kol hanniskalin nitlin, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, eno nitle ella hamegaddef vehaoved avoda zara. haish tolin oto panav kelappe haam, vehaishsha paneha chelappe haetz, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, haish nitle veen haishsha nitlet. amar lahen rabbi eliezer, vahalo shimon ben shatach tala nashim beashkelon. amru lo, shemonim nashim tala, veen danin shenayim beyom echad. ketzad tolin oto, meshakkein et hakkora vaaretz vehaetz yotze mimmenna, umakkif shete yadav zo al gabbe zo vetole oto. rabbi yose omer, hakkora mutta al hakkotel, vetole oto kederech shehattabbachin osin. umattirin oto miyyad. veim lan, over alav belo taase, shenneemar (Devarim 21) lo talin nivlato al haetz ki kavor tikberennu ki killat elohim taluy vegomer. kelomar, mippene ma ze taluy, mippene shebberach et hashshem, venimtza shem shamayim mitchallel:
6.5: Amar rabbi meir, beshaa sheadam mitztaer, shechina ma hallashon omeret kivyachol, kallani meroshi, kallani mizzeroi. im ken hammakom mitztaer al damam shel reshaim shennishpach, kal vachomer al damam shel tzaddikim. velo zo vilvad, ella kol hammelin et meto, over belo taase. helino lichvodo lehavi lo aron vetachrichim, eno over alav. velo hayu kovrin oto bekivrot avotav, ella shete vatte kevarot hayu metukkanin levet din, achat lanneheragin velannechenakin veachat lanniskalin velannisrafin:
6.6: Nitakkel habbasar, melakketin et haatzamot vekovrin otan bimkoman. vehakkerovim baim veshoalin bishlom haddayyanim uvishlom haedim, kelomar sheen belibbenu alechem kelum, sheddin emet dantem. velo hayu mitabbelin, aval onnin, sheen aninut ella vallev:

7.1: Arba mitot nimseru levet din, sekila, serefa, hereg, vachenek. rabbi shimon omer, serefa, sekila, chenek, vahereg. zo mitzvat hanniskalin:
7.2: Mitzvat hannisrafin, hayu meshakkein oto vazzevel ad arkubbotav venotnin sudar kasha letoch harakka vechorech al tzavvaro. ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo ad sheppoteach et piv, umadlik et happetila vezorkah letoch piv veyoredet letoch meav vechomeret et bene meav. rabbi yehuda omer, af hu im met beyadam lo hayu mekayyemin bo mitzvat serefa, ella fotchin et piv bitzvat shello vetovato umadlik et happetila vezorkah letoch piv veyoredet letoch meav vechomeret et bene meav. amar rabbi eliezer ben tzadok, maase bevat kohen achat shezzinneta, vehikkifuha chavile zemorot userafuha. amru lo, mippene shello haya vet din shel otah shaa baki:
7.3: Mitzvat hanneheragim, hayu mattizin et rosho vesayif kederech shehammalchut osa. rabbi yehuda omer, niuul hu ze, ella mannichin et rosho al hassaddan vekotzetz bekofitz. amru lo, en mita menuvvelet mizzo. mitzvat hannechenakin, hayu meshakkein oto vazzevel ad arkubbotav venotnin sudar kasha letoch harakka vechorech al tzavvaro, ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo, ad shennafsho yotza:
7.4: Ellu hen hanniskalin, habba al haem, veal eshet haav, veal hakkalla, veal hazzechur, veal habbehema, vehaishsha hamevia et habbehema, vehamegaddef, vehaoved avoda zara, vehannoten mizzaro lammolech, uvaal ov veyiddeoni, vehamechallel et hashshabbat, vehamekallel aviv veimmo, vehabba al naara hameorasa, vehammesit, vehammaddiach, vehamechashshef, uven sorer umore. habba al haem, chayyav aleha mishshum em umishshum eshet av. rabbi yehuda omer, eno chayyav ella mishshum haem bilvad. habba al eshet av chayyav aleha mishshum eshet av umishshum eshet ish, ben bechayye aviv ben leachar mitat aviv, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin. habba al kallato, chayyav aleha mishshum kallato umishshum eshet ish, ben bechayye veno ben leachar mitat beno, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin. habba al hazzechur veal habbehema, vehaishsha hamevia et habbehema, im adam chata, behema me chatat, ella lefi shebbat laadam takkala al yadah, lefichach amar hakkatuv tissakel. davar acher, shello tehe behema overet bashshuk veyomru zo hi shenniskal peloni al yadah:
7.5: Hamegaddef eno chayyav ad sheyyefaresh hashshem. amar rabbi yehoshua ben karcha, bechol yom danin et haedim bechinnuy yakke yose et yose. nigmar haddin, lo horgim bechinnuy, ella motziim kol adam lachutz veshoalim et haggadol shebbahen veomrim lo emor ma sheshshamata beferush, vehu omer, vehaddayyanim omdin al raglehen vekorin velo meachin. vehashsheni omer af ani kamohu, vehashshelishi omer af ani kamohu:
7.6: Haoved avoda zara, echad haoved, veechad hazzoveach, veechad hamekatter, veechad hamenassech, veechad hammishtachave, veechad hamekabbelo alav leeloah, vehaomer lo eli atta. aval hamegappef vehamenashshek vehamechabbed vehammerabbetz vehammarchitz, hassach, hammalbish vehammanil, over belo taase. hannoder bishmo vehamekayyem bishmo, over belo taase. happoer atzmo levaal peor, zo hi avodato. hazzorek even lemarkulis, zo hi avodato:
7.7: Hannoten mizzaro lammolech, eno chayyav ad sheyyimsor lammolech veyaavir baesh. masar lammolech velo heevir baesh, heevir baesh velo masar lammolech, eno chayyav, ad sheyyimsor lammolech veyaavir baesh. baal ov ze fittom hamedabber mishshechyo, veyiddeoni ze hamedabber befiv, hare ellu viskila, vehannishal bahem beazhara:
7.8: Hamechallel et hashshabbat, bedavar shechayyavin al zedono charet veal shiggato chattat. hamekallel aviv veimmo, eno chayyav ad sheyyekallelem bashshem. killelam bechinnuy, rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin:
7.9: Habba al naara hameorasa, eno chayyav ad shettehe naara vetula meorasa vehi vevet aviha. bau aleha shenayim, harishon biskila vehashsheni bechenek:
7.10: Hammesit, ze hedyot hammesit et hahedyot. amar lo yesh yira vemakom peloni, kach ochelet, kach shota, kach metiva, kach merea. kol chayyave mitot shebbattora en machminin alehem, chutz mizzo. amar lishnayim vehen edav, meviin oto levet din vesoklin oto. amar leechad, hu omer yesh li chaverim rotzim bechach. im haya arum veeno yachol ledabber bifnehem, machminin lo edim achore haggader, vehu omer lo emor ma sheamarta li veyichud, vehalla omer lo, vehu omer lo heach nanniach et elohenu shebbashshamayim venelech venaavod etzim vaavanim. im chozer bo, hare ze mutav. veim amar kach hi chovatenu vechach yafe lanu, haomdin meachore haggader meviin oto levet din vesoklin oto. haomer eevod, elech veeevod, nelech venaavod. azabbeach, elech vaazabbeach, nelech unezabbeach. aktir, elech veaktir, nelech venaktir. anassech, elech vaanassech, nelech unenassech. eshtachave, elech veeshtachave, nelech venishtachave. hammaddiach, ze haomer, nelech venaavod avoda zara:
7.11: Hamechashshef haose maase chayyav, velo haochez et haenayim. rabbi akiva omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, shenayim loktin kishshuin, echad loket patur veechad loket chayyav, haose maase chayyav, haochez et haenayim patur:

8.1: Ben sorer umore, meematay naase ven sorer umore, mishsheyyavi shete searot vead sheyyakkif zakan, hattachton velo haelyon, ella sheddibberu chachamim belashon nekiyya, shenneemar (Devarim 21), ki yihye leish ben, ben velo vat, ben velo ish. hakkatan patur, shello va lichlal mitzvot:
8.2: Meematay chayyav, mishsheyyochal tartemar basar veyishte chatzi log yayin haitalki. rabbi yose omer, mane basar velog yayin. achal bachavurat mitzva, achal beibbur hachodesh, achal maaser sheni birushalayim, achal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim, achal tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, achal davar shehu mitzva vedavar shehu avera, achal kol maachol velo achal basar, shata chol mashke velo shata yayin, eno naase ven sorer umore, ad sheyyochal basar veyishte yayin, shenneemar (Devarim 21) zolel vesove. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar (Mishlei 23) al tehi vesove yayin bezolle vasar lamo:
8.3: Ganav mishshel aviv veachal birshut aviv, mishshel acherim veachal birshut acherim, mishshel acherim veachal birshut aviv, eno naase ven sorer umore, ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv veyochal birshut acherim. rabbi yose var rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv umishshel immo:
8.4: Haya aviv rotze veimmo enah rotza, aviv eno rotze veimmo rotza, eno naase ven sorer umore, ad sheyyehu shenehem rotzim. rabbi yehuda omer, im lo hayta immo reuya leaviv, eno naase ven sorer umore. haya echad mehem giddem o chigger o illem o suma o cheresh, eno naase ven sorer umore, shenneemar (Devarim 21) vetafsu vo aviv veimmo, velo giddemin. vehotziu oto, velo chiggerin. veamru, velo illemin. benenu ze, velo sumin. enennu shomea bekolenu, velo chershin. matrin bo bifne shelosha umalkin oto. chazar vekilkel, niddon beesrim ushelosha. veeno niskal ad sheyyehu sham shelosha harishonim, shenneemar (sham) benenu ze, zehu shellaka bifnechem. barach ad shello nigmar dino veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton, patur. veim mishshennigmar dino barach veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton, chayyav:
8.5: Ben sorer umore niddon al shem sofo, yamut zakkay veal yamut chayyav, shemmitatan shel reshaim hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam, velatztzaddikim, ra lahen vera laolam. yayin veshena larshaim, hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam, velatztzaddikim, ra lahen vera laolam. pizzur larshaim, hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam, velatztzaddikim, ra lahen vera laolam. kinnus larshaim, ra lahen vera laolam, velatztzaddikim, hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam. sheket larshaim, ra lahen vera laolam, velatztzaddikim, hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam:
8.6: Habba vammachteret niddon al shem sofo. haya va vammachteret veshavar et hechavit, im yesh lo damim, chayyav. im en lo damim, patur:
8.7: Veellu hen shemmatztzilin otan benafshan, harodef achar chavero lehargo, achar hazzechur veachar hannaara hameorasa. aval harodef achar behema, vehamechallel et hashshabbat, vehaoved avoda zara, en matztzilin otan benafshan:

9.1: Veellu hen hannisrafin, habba al ishsha uvittah, uvat kohen shezzinneta. yesh bichlal ishsha uvittah, bitto, uvat bitto, uvat beno, uvat ishto, uvat bittah, uvat benah, chamoto, veem chamoto, veem chamiv. veellu hen hanneheragim, harotzeach veanshe ir hanniddachat. rotzeach shehikka et reehu veeven o vevarzel, vechavash alav letoch hammayim o letoch haur veeno yachol laalot mishsham, vamet, chayyav. dechafo letoch hammayim o letoch haur veyachol laalot mishsham, vamet, patur. shissa vo et hakkelev, shissa vo et hannachash, patur. hishshich bo et hannachash, rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. hammakke et chavero ben beeven ben beegrof vaamaduhu lemita, vehekel mimma shehaya uleachar mikkan hichbid vamet, chayyav. rabbi nechemya omer, patur, sheraglayim laddavar:
9.2: Nitkavven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam, lannachri veharag et yisrael, linfalim, veharag ben keyama, patur. nitkavven lehakkoto al matnav velo haya vah kede lehamit al matnav vehalcha lah al libbo vehaya vah kede lehamit al libbo, vamet, patur. nitkavven lehakkoto al libbo vehaya vah kede lehamit al libbo vehalcha lah al matnav velo haya vah kede lehamit al matnav, vamet, patur. nitkavven lehakkot et haggadol velo haya vah kede lehamit haggadol vehalcha lah al hakkatan vehaya vah kede lehamit et hakkatan, vamet, patur. nitkavven lehakkot et hakkatan vehaya vah kede lehamit et hakkatan vehalcha lah al haggadol velo haya vah kede lehamit et haggadol, vamet, patur. aval nitkavven lehakkot al matnav vehaya vah kede lehamit al matnav vehalcha lah al libbo, vamet, chayyav. nitkavven lehakkot et haggadol vehaya vah kede lehamit et haggadol vehalcha lah al hakkatan, vamet, chayyav. rabbi shimon omer, afillu nitkavven laharog et ze veharag et ze, patur:
9.3: Rotzeach shennitarev baacherim, kullan peturin. rabbi yehuda omer, konsin otan lechippa. kol chayyave mitot shennitarvu ze vaze, niddonin bakkalla. hanniskalin bannisrafin, rabbi shimon omer, niddonin biskila, shehasserefa chamura. vachachamim omrim, niddonin bisrefa, shehassekila chamura. amar lahen rabbi shimon, illu lo hayta serefa chamura, lo nittena levat kohen shezzinneta. amru lo, illu lo hayta sekila chamura, lo nittena lamgaddef velaoved avoda zara. hanneheragin bannechenakin, rabbi shimon omer, besayif. vachachamim omrim, bechenek:
9.4: Mi shennitchayyev bishte mitot bet din, niddon bachamura. avar avera shennitchayyev bah shete mitot, niddon bachamura. rabbi yose omer, niddon bazikka harishona shebbaa alav:
9.5: Mi shellaka veshana, bet din machnisim oto lechippa umaachilin oto seorin ad shekkereso mitbakkaat. hahoreg nefesh shello veedim, machnisin oto lechippa umaachilin oto lechem tzar umayim lachatz:
9.6: Haggonev et hakkasva vehamekallel bakkosem vehabboel arammit, kannain pogin bo. kohen sheshshimmesh betuma, en echav hakkohanim meviin oto levet din, ella firche chehunna motziin oto chutz laazara umaftziin et mocho bigzirin. zar sheshshimmesh bammikdash, rabbi akiva omer, bechenek. vachachamim omrim, bide shamayim:

10.1: Kol yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (yeshaya 60) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer. veellu sheen lahem chelek laolam habba, haomer en techiyyat hammetim min hattora, veen tora min hashshamayim, veeppikores. rabbi akiva omer, af hakkore vassefarim hachitzonim, vehallochesh al hammakka veomer (Shemot 15) kol hammachala asher samti vemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha. abba shaul omer, af hahoge et hashshem beotiyyotav:
10.2: Shelosha melachim vearbaa hedyotot en lahem chelek laolam habba. shelosha melachim, yaravam, achav, umenashshe. rabbi yehuda omer, menashshe yesh lo chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (divre hayamim b log) vayyitpallel elav vayyeater lo vayyishma techinnato vayshivehu yerushalayim lemalchuto. amru lo, lemalchuto heshivo velo lechayye haolam habba heshivo. arbaa hedyotot, bilam, vedoeg, vaachitofel, vegechazi:
10.3: Dor hammabbul en lahem chelek laolam habba veen omdin baddin, shenneemar (Bereshit 6) lo yadon ruchi vaadam leolam, lo din velo ruach. dor happallaga en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (Bereshit 11) vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham al pene chol haaretz. vayyafetz Adonai otam, baolam hazze. umishsham hefitzam Adonai, laolam habba. anshe sedom en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (sham 13) veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai meod. raim baolam hazze. vechattaim, laolam habba. aval omdin baddin. rabbi nechemya omer, ellu vaellu en omdin baddin, shenneemar (tehillim 1) al ken lo yakumu reshaim bammishpat vechattaim baadat tzaddikim. al ken lo yakumu reshaim bammishpat, ze dor hammabbul. vechattaim baadat tzaddikim, ellu anshe sedom. amru lo, enam omdim baadat tzaddikim aval omdin baadat reshaim. meraggelim en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa bammaggefa lifne Adonai (Bamidbar 14). vayyamutu, baolam hazze. bammaggefa, baolam habba. dor hammidbar en lahem chelek laolam habba veen omdin baddin, shenneemar (sham) bammidbar hazze yittammu vesham yamutu, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, alehem hu omer (tehillim 50) isfu li chasiday korte veriti ale zavach. adat korach enah atida laalot, shenneemar (Bamidbar 16) vattechas alehem haaretz, baolam hazze, vayyovdu mittoch hakkahal, laolam habba, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, alehem hu omer (Shmuel 1 b) Adonai memit umechayye morid sheol vayyaal. aseret hashshevatim enan atidin lachazor, shenneemar (Devarim 29) vayyashlichem el eretz acheret kayyom hazze, ma hayyom hazze holech veeno chozer, af hem holchim veenam chozrim, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, kayyom hazze, ma hayyom maafil umeir, af aseret hashshevatim sheafal lahen, kach atid lehair lahen:
10.4: Anshe ir hanniddachat en lahen chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (sham 13) yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal mikkirbecha vayyaddichu et yshve iram. veenan neheragim ad sheyyihyu maddicheha meotah hair umeoto hashshevet, vead sheyyuddach rubbah, vead sheyyaddichum anashim. hiddichuha nashim uketannim o shehuddach miutah o shehayu maddicheha chutza lah, hare ellu chichidim. utzerichin shene edim vehateraa lechol echad veechad. ze chomer bayyechidim mibbammerubbim, shehayyechidim biskila, lefichach mamonam palet. vehammerubbim besayif, lefichach mamonam aved:
10.5: Hakke takke et vegomer (Devarim 13). hachammeret vehaggammelet haoveret mimmakom lemakom, hare ellu matztzilin otah. hacharem otah veet kol asher bah veet behemtah lefi charev (sham), mikkan amru nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah ovdin, shebbechutza lah peletin. veshel reshaim, ben shebbetochah ben shebbechutza lah, hare ellu ovdin:
10.6: Veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah vegomer (Devarim 13). im en lah rechov, osin lah rechov. haya rechovah chutza lah, konsin oto letochah. vesarafta vaesh et hair veet kol shelalah kalil laAdonai elohecha (sham). shelalah, velo shelal shamayim. mikkan amru, hahekdeshot shebbah yippadu, uterumot yerakvu, maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh yigganezu. kalil laAdonai elohecha, amar rabbi shimon, amar hakkadosh baruch hu, im attem osim din beir hanniddachat, maale ani alechem keillu attem maalin ola chalil lefanay. vehayta tel olam lo tibbane od (Devarim 13), lo tease afillu gannot ufardesim, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer, lo tibbane od, lichmo shehayta enah nivnet, aval naaset hi gannot ufardesim. velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem (sham), shekkol zeman sheharshaim baolam, charon af baolam. avdu reshaim min haolam, nistallek charon af min haolam:

11.1: Ellu hen hannechenakin, hammakke aviv veimmo, vegonev nefesh miyyisrael, vezaken mamre al pi vet din, unevi hashsheker, vehammitnabbe beshem avoda zara, vehabba al eshet ish, vezomme vat kohen uvoalah. hammakke aviv veimmo eno chayyav ad sheyyaase vahen chabbura. ze chomer bamkallel mibbammakke, shehamekallel leachar mita chayyav, vehammakke leachar mita patur. haggonev nefesh miyyisrael eno chayyav ad sheyyachnisennu lirshuto. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyachnisennu lirshuto veyishtammesh bo, shenneemar (Devarim kad) vehitammer bo umecharo. haggonev et beno, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. ganav mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ven chorin, rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrin:
11.2: Zaken mamre al pi vet din, shenneemar (sham 17) ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat vegomer. shelosha vatte dinin hayu sham, echad yoshev al petach har habbayit, veechad yoshev al petach haazara, veechad yoshev belishkat haggazit. baim laze sheal petach har habbayit, veomer, kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray, kach limmadti vechach limmedu chaveray. im shamu, omrim lahem. veim lav, bain lahem leotan sheal petach haazara, veomer, kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray, kach limmadti vechach limmedu chaveray. im shamu, omrim lahem. veim lav, ellu vaellu baim levet din haggadol shebbelishkat haggazit, shemmimmennu yotzet tora lechol yisrael, shenneemar (sham) min hammakom hahu asher yivchar Adonai. chazar leiro veshana velimmed kederech shehaya lamed, patur. veim hora laasot, chayyav, shenneemar (sham) vehaish asher yaase vezadon, eno chayyav ad sheyyore laasot. talmid shehora laasot, patur, nimtza chumro kullo:
11.3: Chomer bedivre sofrim mibbedivre tora, haomer en tefillin, kede laavor al divre tora, patur. chamishsha totafot, lehosif al divre sofrim, chayyav:
11.4: En memitin oto lo vevet din shebbeiro velo vevet din shebbeyavne, ella maalin oto levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim, umeshammerin oto ad haregel umemitin oto varegel, shenneemar (Devarim 17) vechol haam yishmeu veyirau velo yezidun od, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yehuda omer, en meannin et dino shel ze, ella memitin oto miyyad, vechotvin vesholchin sheluchim bechol hammekomot, ish peloni ben ish peloni nitchayyev mita bevet din:
11.5: Nevi hashsheker hammitnabbe al ma shello shama uma shello neemar lo, mitato vide adam. aval hakkovesh et nevuato, vehamevatter al divre navi, venavi sheavar al divre atzmo, mitato vide shamayim, shenneemar (sham 18) anochi edrosh meimmo:
11.6: Hammitnabbe veshem avoda zara veomer, kach amra avoda zara, afillu chivven et hahalacha, letamme et hattame uletaher et hattahor. habba al eshet ish, kevan shennichnesa lirshut habbaal lannissuin af al pi shello nivala, habba aleha hare ze vechenek. vezomme vat kohen uvoalah, shekkol hazzommin makdimin leotah mita, chutz mizzomme vat kohen uvoalah:
